title: Instantaneous projectile velocity direction from signed components

authority_basis.claim_scope: Repository-backed SBA04 atom derives instantaneous direction from vx and vy and identifies horizontal velocity by vy=0.

concepts.statement: The instantaneous velocity direction is determined by the current signed velocity components, not by the launch angle retained as a fixed label.
concepts.why_required: Direction changes through flight as vy changes while vx stays constant.
concepts.failure_if_omitted: Learners may reuse the launch angle or ignore the sign of vy.

model_conditions.condition: Both velocity components are expressed in the same declared Cartesian frame at the same instant.
model_conditions.physical_reason: A direction angle belongs to one vector represented in one basis at one state.
model_conditions.failure_consequence: Mixing components from different times or frames gives no physical direction.

representations.semantic_geometry: A tangent velocity vector and its signed horizontal/vertical components form the instantaneous direction construction.
must_not_imply: phi always equals launch angle theta
falling velocity has positive vertical direction
horizontal velocity requires zero total velocity
representations.verification_method: Reconstruct the vector from components and check phi is above horizontal for vy>0, zero for vy=0, and below horizontal for vy<0.

reasoning_sequence.expert_action: Obtain the signed current components vx and vy before choosing an angle relation.
reasoning_sequence.failure_if_skipped: The launch components or launch angle may be reused at a later instant.

reasoning_sequence.expert_action: Use the component pair to resolve the quadrant-correct instantaneous direction.
reasoning_sequence.failure_if_skipped: The sign of vy may disappear and rising/falling directions can be conflated.

required_transformations.description: Translate current signed velocity components into a tangent velocity direction with an explicit horizontal reference.
Use the quadrant-correct direction relation to identify horizontal-velocity or specified-angle events, solve the requested state, and verify the component signs.

misconceptions.incorrect_model: The projectile's velocity angle remains equal to the launch angle throughout the flight.
misconceptions.why_plausible: The launch angle is visually prominent and vx is constant in the standard model.
misconceptions.required_counterexample: At the apex vy=0, so the velocity is horizontal even when the launch angle was nonzero.
misconceptions.required_representation_repair: Show different component triangles at launch, apex and falling states.
misconceptions.required_technical_repair: Recompute direction from current vx and vy rather than reusing theta.
misconceptions.verification: Evaluate phi at apex and confirm phi=0 when vx is nonzero.

problem_families.name: Instantaneous projectile direction
problem_families.first_technical_move: Find current signed vx and vy before evaluating the direction angle.
fatal_errors: set whole velocity to zero for horizontal velocity
